bio.text: Donna Veach has represented Connecticut's 30th House District since 2021 and is the Republican candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
She lives in Berlin, Connecticut, and earned an A.S. in merchandising/marketing from Post University and a bachelor's degree in business administration from American InterContinental University.
Her career includes work as development and marketing director of Hungerford Nature Center and New Britain Youth Museum, and owning Copperpott Farms.
